name: Unseen synthetic case

capability.note: Reported hot-spot is checked against oil and the winding reference.

drift.method: One-sided five-minute CUSUM; healthy-prefix assumption; screening, not a cooling-fault diagnosis.

alerts.detail: Temperature is rising rapidly at nearly constant load; inspect cooling and verify the probe.

maintenance: Review loading and compare a load-reduction study against the current thermal trajectory.
Inspect cooling and compare temperature against an independent reference.

result.next_action: Use the conditional trajectory with current alerts; reassess on each observation.
result.assumptions: Nominal cooling and constant observed inputs; no fault label or hidden state. A clear residual is not proof that every fault is absent. Reported temperatures initialise the conditional forecast; parameter mismatch remains possible.

note: Fault label, seed and later observations remain withheld until assessment. Synthetic experiment; no field-accuracy claim.

scores.note: All available future target observations are retained, including future input changes. No score is evidence of safety or diagnostic certainty.
